Note: Not too long, but long enough that its noot wworth 10k to do daily, but easy to do once in a while to get to 30 quests.

DON'T RECOMMEND: Don't hand this in, do it and keep your Oubliette flag open. You need to only flag once in the 3 towers and then you can skip straight to the boss daily if you like (I wouldn't, but I'd do it to get to 30). Flagging is easy if you use a flame rare for the SE/SW towers UPDATE: this was bugged for me, it does lock you out of the castle and you need to re-do the flag each time to get in. This is more of a pain to use it now, but the only way to get to Oubliette

Time consuming but once you're flagged you can run it right after defeating the shade of Lord R in Mhoire castle, just need to collect so many of those stupid portal gems. UPDATE: Don't hand in Shade of Lord R for Mhoire castle and you can skip all that flagging and just run this each time, I recommend that, have to do Mhoire castle just the first time if done that way
Done by the server daily at 8:30 PM EST. Also done like 30 more times throughout the day, just join in, or learn how to open and do it yourself :D
Small lum, so I wouldn't run it daily since its a bit out of the way, but its super easy. Run through rynthid talking to 5 shadows in a neat dungeon. One of the more unique dungeons.
Not worth 10k Lum, but soloable. Dont' alert the guards in the first 2 rooms, then destroy the door once you're through the first door you can run through and hand out your 3 oils in a linear path

Pain in the ass, 4 dungeons. Run through hitting switches, or doing jumps and finally following the lightning on the floor in a tedius walk through room. (There is a skip for this, search discord for Nan's youtube video showing the skip of the last room)
Rynth recall. If you want to solo it, bring a lightning rare and its simplified
Gives a great necklace, a bit too long to be a daily quest. Can easily be solo'd if you're able to navigate rynthid Virindi, if not you can easily get through with 1-2 friends.
Incredibly easy, though a bit buggy and you may need to reset from time to time, hopefully it gets fixed. Either way, Easy as hell to run.
Followed by Curator daily, also easy to solo.
Followed by Lugian Assault daily, also easy to solo.
Hosh quest, short dungeon, boss fight has a lot of tanky friends but with enough melee D they dont' really hit you. Bring a friend to make this fight go quicker.
More Hosh, this one I feel needed at least 1 other person, can be solo'd but the enemies hit so hard and the last room has a bit if you run too quickly through to it as it locks you in.

This is two quests but it only counts as 1, each give 15k lum each. One is collecting 6 items in the dungeon and the other is defeating the boss at the end of the dungeon, so do them together. Part of the Ninja academy quest chain and for some reason is easier than part 1
Third part of the quest chain, still easier than part 1, lol. Just do them all together but I probably wouldn't do these daily but to get to 30.. yes
Best done with a large group, don't see this run enough.

Would love to see this done daily but it definitely needs a group. Okay people can solo this, but its better off with a group. Update: There is a nice wall jump skip you can see an ATW youtube video showing this, makes it easier to solo.

UPDATE: Been seeing this run more often lately, flag for this quest and its an easy 40k lum and a good check on the john quests. Some people like to do this daily, I've only run it once at this point. Did it with 3 people, seemed like a solid number to do it with, the boss wave hits hard (4th wave)
Another good daily you should be doing if you're not learn the maze and the jumps and you can be through it quick for some nice lum.
Hoard bs3s in your inventory and do this one daily, best source of lum, a bit harder than the previous quests but easily soloable.

I'd put this further down the list but its so convientent to do right after bs3, the exit of bs3 brings you right to study, getting the pages and the symbols are a pain and Geraine takes a while to go down. Bring a friend to make it tolerable
Really easy, would be up higher if it was better than 10k lum, not worth the time to do daily but easy to throw in next time you're in FV and looking to get up to 30 quests.
Do all 3 sister quests solo, as they each require you to pick up 10-15 items and hand to a bulb. First sisters, beware the reedsharks, they hit hard. Don't take them lightly.

Soloable for sure, but I don't like this quest. Using the scrying rod is stupid, and it makes you do it twice. It also makes you clear out the entire dungeon worth of enemies to proceed, no skipping fights, bah
Neftet recall, talk to NPC. Another daily, just be careful of the void statues.

Newly added quest, worthy of being daily I might move this up the list with some more practice. 2 crystals to progress through the dungeon, just be careful of the spirits spamming war, don't get careless like me :D Update: I moved this below Janthef, do them together while at Neftet, might be worth doing daily just less lum than janthef

UPDATE: I moved this up the list. Tge first four dungeons is a flag for the final part in Neftet, do it once then you can do a fairly quick quest for 20k Lum. Not the fastest 20k lum quest but its 100% worth being one of your 30 now. Only reason its so low is it takes time, 4 dungeons on the corners of the map and then another dungeon with a boss room at the end. If you don't like jumping puzzles, you might skip this. Recommend doing this quest at least once though, its a fun one just long. First 4 dungeons are easy, last dungeon picks up the difficulty a little but all soloable
Needs to spawn more ore, be careful of the war spam in the ore collecting area. Not too bad, do it alone.

Do this to unlock the 3rd sister, and do it as part of your 30 if you have high enough jump (600+) to do it each time. If not, use a jump rare the first time to unlock sister 3 and skip in the future.

Out of the way quest, wouldn't run this daily. Extra 5k lum if you grab the book from an easy jump puzzle. Easy enough to be in the top 30. First quest in the 3 sister quest chain, follow up with 3 sisters.
A good daily, a lot of people wait until someone collects the keys then tags along. I did that too, but then I learned the keys and they're super simple, good daily quest.
Another good daily to do, a bit out of the way. Tie to tumerok caves on an alt and have a candeth portal (or get the recall) for quick turn in and it becomes a good daily
One of the first legendary quests you probably learned and most people can do with their eyes closed.
Another daily many people do, if you don't next time you see someone liberating uziz, tag along its quick and easy.
This is really easy, just a bit out of the way in my opinion. Honestly could be a decent daily.

The dungeon is quick to get to, easy to navigate and the boss packs a mean punch. Bring someone who can debuff the boss and tugak his sclavus swarm, that'd be nice. The sclavus have high melee D and the boss hurts, debuff that sword. I recommend 2-3 people though it could be solo'd . UPDATE- I solo'd this, debuff his sword and its a pain in the ass but doable, took too long though solo.

The longest part of this was finding the portal in the first dungeon, once you find it and go through to the last dungeon, you can tie to the end and skip most of this quest, but you still have to deal with triangles of death and a boss that will instant kill you. Not TERRIBLe but I still don't care much for it

I wanted to put this above slave master because fuck slave master, but collecting all 7 Geraine's books takes sooo long. I want to confirm you need all 7 and not just the first 1-4 hand in to get credit UPDATE: You only need to hand in books 1-4 for this to count, still time consuming
Way too time consuming, not hard but dropping 5 forks is long enough as it is. One of last one's I'd do if ever.
